exact_bin_findings.role: Exact first instruction of the double-exception vector at vector base 0x40378000 + 0x3c0; confirmed against official v5.5.4 vector and linker layout.

exact_bin_findings.context: entry at 0x4038c2b4, retw.n at 0x4038c2ba; no matching ELF symbol assigned.
A8 literal from 0x40379130 is 0x4225bb4c. That function iterates per-core callback slots and calls exact 0x4038c2b4 waiti function; structurally consistent with idle-hook flow.

IRAM function entry 0x40383c6c has exact cache_ll_l1_get_bus/file-name string literals and reads/modifies ICACHE/DCACHE bus controls 0x600c4064/0x600c4004. Dump arguments include vaddr 0x3cb80000, Flash paddr 0x00a00000, size 0x00400000, consistent with Assets mmap. This is concurrent context, not proof of a cache-model defect.

Exact debug-vector target: 0x40378280 saves EXCSAVE6 then jumps here. This independently confirms that EXCCAUSE=1 and EPC1=BREAK PC in the panic are overwritten debug state, not the original double-exception cause/EPC.

why_panic_cause_is_insufficient: Official debug handler overwrites EXCCAUSE with PANIC_RSN_DEBUGEXCEPTION and copies debug EPC into EPC1. The printed EXCCAUSE=1 and final BREAK PC cannot identify the original exception that entered the double vector. EXCVADDR may also be stale unless the original cause was a memory fault.

minimal_next_observation.change: Ignored diagnostic source only: first EXC_DOUBLE per CPU at xtensa_cpu_do_interrupt before assigning the double vector. Do not change exception handling, timing, firmware or clock.
minimal_next_observation.why: Captures original exception state before BREAK/debug panic overwrites it. Emit at most once per CPU. Capture only the current CPU; do not race-read the other CPU state.
minimal_next_observation.optional_control: Only after original-cause capture, a separate same-BIN comparison can disable compiled Module reuse while preserving new Instance/Memory/FS each run. A single cold/warm difference does not establish module-cache causality.
